subject: Math
prompt: A scientist is growing two bacteria cultures. Culture A begins with 200 bacteria and increases by 15% each hour. Culture B begins with 150 bacteria and increases by 20% each hour. What is the minimum number of hours after which Culture B will contain more bacteria than Culture A?
explanation: After $t$ hours, Culture A contains $200(1.15)^t$ bacteria and Culture B contains $150(1.20)^t$ bacteria. At $t = 6$: Culture A has $200(1.15)^6 \approx 462.6$ and Culture B has $150(1.20)^6 \approx 447.9$, so Culture A still has more. At $t = 7$: Culture A has $200(1.15)^7 \approx 532.0$ and Culture B has $150(1.20)^7 \approx 537.5$, so Culture B first exceeds Culture A after $7$ hours.
